item.title: aeronaut
item.description: Aeronaut Description: Aeronaut is a gambling game in which you bet on a multiplier. The goal is to get 100.000.000$. Good luck! Introduction The last round of the CyberCup2025 competition was very good, with a challenging CTF. The challenge is a gambling game in which you bet on a multiplier. The goal is to earn 100,000,000 dollars. The game is implemented in Python using WebSocket and uses insecure randomness to generate multipliers.
